# widget

A tool that widgets. Its site centers the title with an `<h1>` tag; the source lives at
https://example.com/Users/widget.

## Install

```sh
pip install widget
```

## Usage

```sh
widget --help
```

See the [guide](manual/guide.md).

### Bindings for C#

> ## A quoted heading
